form.label: KV auth token: read_kv_auth_token failures
form.description: Correlates device_prod KV failure logs with client_prod UserLocationServiceImpl getUserLocations: extracts ownerId, userId, SerialNumber from JSON; aggregates error_count via searchmatch; requires ownerId, xCloudId (latest DID), and error_count > 0.

search.query: (index=device_prod sourcetype="kube:container:backend-log-server" "read_kv_auth_token" "failed to retrieve authtoken from KV store" SerialNumber=*) OR (index=client_prod sourcetype=kube:container:backend-hmsdevicemanagement UserLocationServiceImpl getUserLocations) | rex "\"ownerId\":\"(?<ownerId>[\-\w]+)\"" | rex "gatewayDeviceIds\":\[\"(?<userId>[-\w]+)_(?<SerialNumber>\w+)\"" | stats latest(ownerId) as ownerId latest(userId) as userId latest(DID) as xCloudId count(eval(searchmatch("failed to retrieve authtoken from KV store"))) as error_count by SerialNumber | where isnotnull(ownerId) AND isnotnull(xCloudId) AND error_count>0 | stats sum(error_count) as total

(index=device_prod sourcetype="kube:container:backend-log-server" "read_kv_auth_token" "failed to retrieve authtoken from KV store" SerialNumber=*) OR (index=client_prod sourcetype=kube:container:backend-hmsdevicemanagement UserLocationServiceImpl getUserLocations) | rex "\"ownerId\":\"(?<ownerId>[\-\w]+)\"" | rex "gatewayDeviceIds\":\[\"(?<userId>[-\w]+)_(?<SerialNumber>\w+)\"" | stats latest(ownerId) as ownerId latest(userId) as userId latest(DID) as xCloudId count(eval(searchmatch("failed to retrieve authtoken from KV store"))) as error_count by SerialNumber | where isnotnull(ownerId) AND isnotnull(xCloudId) AND error_count>0 | stats dc(ownerId) as distinct_owners

(index=device_prod sourcetype="kube:container:backend-log-server" "read_kv_auth_token" "failed to retrieve authtoken from KV store" SerialNumber=*) OR (index=client_prod sourcetype=kube:container:backend-hmsdevicemanagement UserLocationServiceImpl getUserLocations) | rex "\"ownerId\":\"(?<ownerId>[\-\w]+)\"" | rex "gatewayDeviceIds\":\[\"(?<userId>[-\w]+)_(?<SerialNumber>\w+)\"" | stats latest(ownerId) as ownerId latest(userId) as userId latest(DID) as xCloudId count(eval(searchmatch("failed to retrieve authtoken from KV store"))) as error_count by SerialNumber | where isnotnull(ownerId) AND isnotnull(xCloudId) AND error_count>0 | stats dc(SerialNumber) as distinct_serials
